name: robots/robin-shaun__xtdrone
title: XTDrone typhoon_h480_0 position bridge
intro: XTDrone typhoon_h480_0 position bridge, adapted from robin-shaun/xtdrone. It reads `read_target` and `read_position`; runs `publish_position_setpoint`. `publish_position_setpoint`: publish one map-frame local position setpoint to MAVROS; the receipt reports the values handed to rosbridge and is transmission only, not arrival or a stop. A simulator: the market serves it with a stand-in that needs no simulator install.
